exact_statement: Let h be any uniform Boolean core, p its squared Fourier law and q a normalized dominating supplied core reference. Calibrate its empty mass once to p(empty), preserving its nonempty conditional law, to obtain q*. With B the binary KL of the old versus actual empty masses, CE(p,q*)=CE(p,q)-B. For F_h=(-1)^a on x0, h on x1b1,+1 otherwise, copy the actual six control/character sector masses and put q*(s)/16 on each of four control masks for every nonempty data frequency. This is a normalized dominating correlation-preserving complete reference Q with D(P_F||Q)=D(p||q*)/4 and CE(P_F,Q)<=3+CE(p,q*)/4. For C>=4 a supplied CE(p,q*)<=C I(h) gives root reference-inclusive margin>=C-3+C Pr(h=-1)/2. Query b then any finite adaptive fresh data-only tree in b1, retaining b0 and keeping x,a unqueried, with supplied actual H(g)<=C I(g) certificates at every core terminal. Transport the SAME Q by actual coherent kernels, fair fallback on source-zero rows, retaining all reference-only rows. For A=D(P_F||Q), e=Hroot-EHleaf-C(Iroot-EIleaf), S=E(CIleaf-Hleaf), the signed liability J=[A+e]+ leaves S-J>=C-3. At C=4 an eligible old conservative booking omega<=1/4 leaves at least3/4 from that same owner, with all source erasure/outcome and inherited terminal KL in A once. At rate4 one further x or a query on selected active data-frontier leaves, stopping at both new children and retaining b0, also leaves that margin: x child pairs have mean surplus>=2, a child pairs have mean surplus>=0, and the untouched b0 contributes1, so total S>=1. For any m>=1,r>=2 disjoint width-r point factors, choose q_r(empty)=p_r(empty), q_r(s)=(7/8)p_r(s)+(4*2^-r*(1-2^-r)/8)1_full(s) on nonempty s and q=product q_r. This is nonmatching and CE(h,q)<4I(h)-m*2^-r, so the theorem applies in every dimension including the existing canonical counterfamilies. At m512,r2, A>2 while complete-data final S=2; source-only conservative payment fails but the signed net is negative and paid. The construction compares initial references at the same reached Boolean root; it does not cancel a previously owed canonical source or pay a free descendant reset. Arbitrary-core supplied prices, mixed-query frontier eligibility and fresh inherited-reference conversion remain open; full FEI is not proved.

exact_statement: For independent funded seed functions f_j with normalized dominating initial references Q_j and independent finite physical stopping policies, put M_j=4I(f_j)-CE(P_j,Q_j), S_j=E(4Ileaf-Hleaf), A_j=KL(P_j||Q_j), and e_j=Hroot-EHleaf-4(Iroot-EIleaf). The exact signed remaining owner is min(S_j,M_j). Product accounts retain at least the sum of seed signed reserves, with exact T-fold scaling for identical seeds and policies. Let W=1+AND_k(C)(z product_j f_j-1), alpha=2^-k, with independent balanced retained z and all controls exposed before the seed policies. Use the normalized initial reference that retains the actual z-absent quotient spectrum and replaces the seed product spectrum by product Q_j only in the z-present sector. Then H,CE and KL obey the exact lift identities in PROOF section2, I(W)=alpha(k+1+sum I(f_j)), S_W=4alpha+alpha sum S_j, and M_W=beta_k+alpha sum M_j with beta_k=4alpha(k+1)-H(W0)>=0. Hence S_W-[A_W+e_W]_+>=alpha sum min(S_j,M_j). Old eligible seed bookings omega_j are carried once at reach alpha. Applied to A050 v1 mixed b/data/one-x-or-a policies, every m>=1,r>=2 point-tensor supplier retains at least3alpha T/4 after old omega_j<=1/4, including all controller source releases and full inherited terminal references. This signed account has no extra T log T bill and is not the refuted A+[e]_+ account. An unqueried spectator changes S by4I-H and M by4I-CE, so an unpriced reference cannot yield free credit. No free descendant reset, incoming canonical debt cancellation, arbitrary-core supplier, or universal FEI claim follows.
